summary: # Changelog ## 0.2.81 - Fixed `canUseTool` not providing a working `addRules` suggestion when a write under `.claude/skills/{name}/` hits the bypass-immune safety check - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.81 ## 0.2.80 - Fixed `getSessionMessages()` dropping parallel tool results — sessions with parallel tool calls now return all tool_use/tool_result pairs - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.80 ## 0.2.79 - Added `'resume'` to the `ExitReason` type for distinguishing resume-triggered session ends in hooks - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.79
